what.label: What it is
what.title: A living biomathematical model of you
what.body: The Human Data Model is a digital twin built from verified labs, clinical notes, medications, symptoms, and lifestyle signals. It keeps one continuous structure — so Health Guide can reason over your full history, not isolated snapshots.

points.title: One model, many sources
points.body: Scattered reports become a single biomathematical structure you can revisit as life changes.

points.title: Context over charts
points.body: Numbers matter when they connect to diagnosis, treatment, and what you actually feel.

points.title: Built to last decades
points.body: Every important event updates the twin — so tomorrow’s question still has yesterday’s evidence.

what.vizTitle: Signals converging into the Human Data Model
what.vizCaption: Verified inputs feed one model — not a pile of disconnected dashboards.

steps.body: Four steps. No lifestyle filler — just how the model becomes useful.
